title: Response::to_string allocates per-line String for every response
description: O(N) PER-COMMAND ALLOCATION — Response::to_string (response.rs:239) calls write!() per body line via the fmt::Display impl, which forces string allocation through to_string() before write_all at each command dispatch in lifecycle.rs. For OVER responses with 10 000 body lines this is 10 000 format! calls inside the Display impl, then .to_string() materialises the full response into a single String before any bytes hit the wire. Fix: write directly to a pre-allocated BytesMut or use a write-to-writer path that avoids materialising the full response String.
